faq.q: What age do you have to be to throw axes?
faq.a: All ages 10 and up (with a parent present for minors). All participants must sign a waiver before throwing.
Closed-toe shoes are required for all participants - no sandals, flip-flops, or open-toed shoes. Beyond that, wear whatever you're comfortable in.

faq.q: Can we bring outside food and drinks?
faq.a: Outside food and catering are welcome - just bring your own utensils and napkins. Outside drinks are not permitted; we serve craft beer, seltzers, and other beverages on site.
Free on-site parking (a real lot, no apps required).
Rescheduling is available for events. Refunds are not provided for cancellations. Please contact the venue as soon as possible if your plans change.
No - watching is always free. Only active throwers need a session.
Each lane holds up to 4 throwers. We can reserve multiple lanes or the entire venue for private buyouts.

faq.q: Can we book an event outside normal business hours?
faq.a: Yes - off-hours private events are available with at least one week of advance notice. Contact the venue to discuss availability and pricing.

faq.q: Do I need to book ahead?
faq.a: Strongly recommended, especially Friday/Saturday nights and any weekend. We take walk-ins when lanes are open, but can't guarantee a lane without a reservation.
Every venue is wheelchair accessible. We can adapt the throwing setup for seated throwers - just let us know in advance.

Monday: fill a lane with up to 6 throwers for $80 per 1-hour session. Thursday: Ladies throw for 50% off (groups of four or fewer). Sunday: Kids ages 10–15 throw free with an equivalent purchased regular session; adult must be present.
Join the Birthday Club and get a free-throw voucher the week of your birthday. Show the email at check-in.
